k: HYDRA's leader, Johann Schmidt
st: Red Skull breaks HYDRA away from the Nazis and arms it with the power of the Tesseract.
Red Skull grabs the Tesseract aboard his bomber, and its light carries him away.
In 2014, Red Skull greets Clint and Natasha on Vormir as keeper of the Soul Stone.
Red Skull guides Thanos to the Soul Stone on Vormir and names its price.

k: HYDRA's top scientist
st: Zola builds HYDRA's weapons, until the Howling Commandos capture him off a train.
Zola's mind, saved in a computer, reveals HYDRA grew inside S.H.I.E.L.D. before a missile destroys him.

k: A HYDRA assassin
st: Kruger kills Dr. Erskine after the serum test, then takes cyanide when Steve catches him.

k: Tony Stark's mentor at Stark Industries
st: Stane secretly sells Stark weapons to terrorists and has paid the Ten Rings to kill Tony.
Stane builds the Iron Monger suit and dies in the arc reactor blast during his fight with Iron Man.

k: Leader of the Ten Rings cell holding Tony Stark
st: Raza holds Tony Stark captive in Afghanistan and orders him to build a Jericho missile.
Raza brings the wrecked armor to Obadiah Stane, who paralyzes him and has him killed.

k: A Russian physicist with a grudge against the Starks
st: Vanko attacks Tony Stark at the Monaco Grand Prix with electric whips and is arrested.
Freed by Justin Hammer, Vanko turns Hammer's drones on the Stark Expo and dies in his own blast.

k: A rival weapons maker
st: Hammer fakes Vanko's death and hires him to build drones for the Stark Expo.
The drones run wild at the Expo, and Hammer is arrested.
Hammer holds court in Seagate Prison and resents the fame of fellow inmate Trevor Slattery.

k: A senator demanding the Iron Man suit
st: Stern grills Tony at a Senate hearing and demands he hand over the suit.
Stern turns out to be HYDRA and is arrested after the helicarriers fall.

n: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
k: A Royal Marine hungry for more power
st: Blonsky takes a super soldier serum and Banner's blood, then tears up Harlem as a monster.
The Hulk beats Blonsky, who is taken into custody.
Blonsky, in Abomination form, fights Wong in a Macau cage match.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Blonsky wins parole with Jennifer Walters as his lawyer, saying he has changed.
Blonsky breaks the terms of his parole and is sent back to prison.
Wong opens a portal into Blonsky's cell and takes him away.

k: A US Army general hunting the Hulk
st: General Ross hunts Bruce Banner and pushes Blonsky into becoming a weapon.
Now Secretary of State, Ross pushes the Sokovia Accords and locks rogue Avengers in the Raft.
Ross hunts Natasha Romanoff for breaking the Accords.
Ross orders the arrest of Steve Rogers and his team when they return to the Avengers Compound.
Ross stands among the mourners at Tony Stark's funeral.
President Ross turns into the Red Hulk in Washington, then turns himself in and goes to the Raft.

k: A cell biologist helping Bruce Banner
st: Sterns studies Banner's blood, and a drop in a head wound starts to change him.
Sterns, now the Leader, mind-controls soldiers into attacks that push the US and Japan toward war.
Sam Wilson stops the Leader's plan, and Sterns ends up locked in the Raft.

k: Thor's brother, a prince of Asgard
st: Loki learns he is a Frost Giant, takes Asgard's throne, and falls into the void off the Bifrost.
Loki steals the Tesseract and leads a Chitauri invasion of New York, until the Avengers capture him.
Loki fights beside Thor against the Dark Elves, fakes his death, and takes Odin's throne in disguise.
Loki joins Thor to save Asgard's people from Hela.
Thanos kills Loki aboard the Asgardian refugee ship.
In 2012, the captured Loki grabs the Tesseract during the Avengers' time heist and escapes.
The TVA catches that Loki, and he slowly becomes an ally in the hunt for a dangerous variant.
Loki takes the throne at the end of time to hold the timelines together.

k: King of the Frost Giants of Jotunheim
st: Laufey's Frost Giants raid Odin's vault, and Thor's revenge attack breaks the old truce.
Laufey sneaks into Asgard to kill Odin at Loki's invitation, and Loki kills him.

k: Thanos's hooded envoy to the Chitauri
st: The Other gives Loki the Chitauri army and warns him not to fail.
The Other brings Thanos's warning to Ronan, and Ronan kills him.

k: A warlord who courts death
st: Thanos backs the Chitauri invasion of Earth from the shadows.
Thanos sends Ronan for the Orb, but Ronan keeps the stone inside for himself.
Thanos puts on an empty gauntlet and vows to get the stones himself.
Thanos gathers all six Infinity Stones and wipes out half of all life with a snap.
Thor kills Thanos in his garden, and a 2014 Thanos who follows the Avengers forward turns to dust.

k: A broke couple who find a Chitauri gun
st: Benny and Claire rob banks with a salvaged Chitauri gun.
Agent Sitwell catches them, and S.H.I.E.L.D. hires them instead of jailing them.

k: Ruler of the Dark Elves of Svartalfheim
st: Malekith wakes when Jane Foster absorbs the Aether, and attacks Asgard to take it.
Malekith tries to darken the universe at the Convergence in Greenwich, and his own ship crushes him.

k: Malekith's loyal lieutenant, Algrim
st: Algrim becomes the Kursed, breaks out of Asgard's prison, and kills Frigga in the raid.
Kurse runs Loki through on Svartalfheim, and Loki kills him with his own black hole grenade.

k: A Kree Accuser and fanatic
st: In 1995, Ronan's fleet comes to Earth to destroy the Skrulls' hideout, but Carol drives it off.
Ronan takes the Power Stone, betrays Thanos, and tries to destroy Xandar.
The Guardians share the stone's power and destroy Ronan.

k: A Kree hunter working for Ronan
st: In 1995, Korath serves with the Kree Starforce hunting Skrulls.
Korath hunts Peter Quill for the Orb and dies at Drax's hands.

k: Thanos's daughter and Ronan's lieutenant
st: Nebula serves Ronan, then flees after Gamora beats her.
Nebula hunts Gamora, makes peace with her, and leaves to kill Thanos.
Thanos captures and tortures Nebula, but she escapes to fight him on Titan.
Nebula joins the Avengers' time heist and kills her 2014 self, who works for Thanos.
Nebula fights beside Thor and the Guardians before the two teams part ways.
Nebula spends Christmas on Knowhere with the Guardians.
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
Nebula fights beside the Guardians to save Rocket's life.

k: Ravager captain who raised Peter Quill
st: Kraglin recalls how Yondu ruined Christmas for a young Peter Quill aboard his ship.
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
Yondu hunts Peter Quill for the Orb, but Peter hands him a fake.
Yondu helps save Peter from Ego and dies giving him his space suit.

k: A living planet who says he is Peter Quill's father
st: Ego reveals he planted seeds on countless worlds to remake the galaxy as himself.
Groot sets a bomb on Ego's core, and Ego dies.

k: High Priestess of the Sovereign
st: Ayesha hunts the Guardians after Rocket steals her batteries, and creates Adam.
Ayesha sends Adam Warlock after Rocket for the High Evolutionary.
Ayesha dies when the High Evolutionary bombs Counter-Earth.

k: A mutinous Ravager
st: Taserface leads a mutiny against Yondu and dies when the Ravager ship explodes.

k: Commander of the Kree Starforce
st: Yon-Rogg trains Vers as a Kree soldier and hides that he took her past.
Carol beats Yon-Rogg on Earth and sends him back to Hala with a warning.

k: The AI that rules the Kree
st: The Supreme Intelligence holds Carol back with a Kree implant, until she breaks free.
Flashbacks show Carol destroying the Supreme Intelligence, and Hala falls into civil war.

k: A Kree Starforce sniper
st: Minn-Erva hunts Carol and the Skrulls, and Carol shoots down her ship.

k: A shape-shifting Skrull commander
st: Talos hunts Vers on Earth, posing as Nick Fury's boss.
Talos reveals the Skrulls are refugees, and Carol helps them escape.
Talos poses as Nick Fury to guide Peter Parker through the Elemental attacks in Europe.
Talos helps Fury hunt Gravik's Skrull rebels, and Gravik kills him.

k: Head of Advanced Idea Mechanics
st: Killian hides his Extremis soldiers' blasts behind a fake terrorist, the Mandarin.
Killian kidnaps the President and Pepper, and Pepper kills him.

k: The face of the Mandarin's broadcasts
st: Trevor, an actor, plays the Mandarin on TV for Killian, and is arrested once the hoax falls apart.
Ten Rings agents break Trevor out of Seagate, and he vanishes from the prison.
Trevor, kept by Wenwu as a jester, helps Shang-Chi reach Ta Lo, then goes off on his own.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Trevor spies on Simon Williams for Damage Control, and the two become close friends.
Trevor claims Simon's set explosion as the Mandarin and goes to a Damage Control prison.
Simon breaks Trevor out of the prison, and the two escape together.

k: A botanist who created Extremis
st: Maya works on Extremis for Killian, then turns on him to help Tony, and Killian shoots her dead.

k: Killian's Extremis enforcer
st: Savin attacks Air Force One to take the President, and Iron Man blasts him out of the plane.

k: An Extremis soldier
st: Brandt and Savin attack Tony in Tennessee, and Brandt dies in the fight.

k: The US Vice President
st: Rodriguez helps Killian's plot in return for a cure for his daughter, and is arrested.

k: A filmmaker interviewing Trevor Slattery
st: Norriss reveals he is a Ten Rings agent and takes Trevor to meet the real Mandarin.

k: A senior S.H.I.E.L.D. official
st: In 2012, Pierce argues with the Avengers over who keeps the Tesseract.
Pierce reveals himself as HYDRA and aims Project Insight's helicarriers at millions.
Nick Fury shoots Pierce dead as the helicarriers fall.

k: A ghost assassin with a metal arm
st: The Winter Soldier hunts Nick Fury and Captain America, and turns out to be Bucky Barnes.
Bucky pulls Steve out of the Potomac and vanishes.
Steve and Sam hold Bucky with his metal arm pinned in a vise.
Framed for the UN bombing, Bucky goes on the run, then chooses to be frozen in Wakanda.
Bucky wakes from cryosleep in Wakanda, and Shuri checks on him.
Bucky gets a new arm in Wakanda, fights Thanos's army, and turns to dust after the snap.
Bucky returns for the final battle against Thanos's army.
Bucky makes amends for the Winter Soldier's killings and fights the Flag Smashers beside Sam.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Now a congressman, Bucky joins the team that becomes the New Avengers.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. strike team leader
st: In 2012, Rumlow's team guards Loki's scepter and loses it to a time-traveling Captain America.
Rumlow reveals he is HYDRA and fights Cap, and a crashing helicarrier leaves him badly burned.
Rumlow, now Crossbones, raids Lagos and blows himself up, and the blast kills Wakandan aid workers.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent
st: In 2012, Sitwell hands Loki's scepter to a time-traveling Cap who whispers Hail HYDRA.
Sitwell gives up HYDRA's plan for Project Insight, then the Winter Soldier kills him.

k: A French mercenary and kickboxer
st: Batroc's pirates seize a S.H.I.E.L.D. ship, and he escapes after a fight with Captain America.
Batroc works with the Flag Smashers for money, and Sharon Carter kills him.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: A HYDRA leader studying Loki's scepter
st: Strucker experiments with Loki's scepter and holds two enhanced twins.
The Avengers raid Strucker's base in Sokovia and capture him.
Ultron kills Strucker in his cell.

k: Tony Stark's peacekeeping AI gone wrong
st: Ultron wakes in Stark's lab, builds himself a body, and decides humanity must go.
Ultron lifts Sokovia into the sky, and Vision destroys his last body.

k: A Sokovian test subject in Strucker's lab
st: Pietro is held in Strucker's HYDRA lab as a test subject.
Pietro joins Ultron, then turns on him and dies saving Clint in Sokovia.

k: A Sokovian test subject in Strucker's lab
st: Wanda is held in Strucker's HYDRA lab as a test subject.
Wanda joins Ultron, then sees his real plan and fights beside the Avengers in Sokovia.
A blast Wanda tries to contain in Lagos kills aid workers, and she sides with Cap until Steve frees her from the Raft.
Wanda destroys the Mind Stone to keep it from Thanos, then turns to dust after his snap.
Wanda returns and fights the 2014 Thanos in the final battle.
Grieving Vision, Wanda traps Westview in a sitcom world, then lets it go and flies off with the Darkhold.
As the Scarlet Witch, Wanda hunts America Chavez across the multiverse to reach her sons.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
Wanda destroys the Darkhold in every universe and brings Mount Wundagore down on herself.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

k: An arms dealer who stole vibranium
st: Klaue sells vibranium to Ultron, who cuts off his arm.
Klaue robs a museum, escapes custody in Busan, and Killmonger kills him.

k: Hank Pym's former protege, now CEO of Pym Tech
st: Cross perfects the Yellowjacket shrinking suit to sell to HYDRA.
Ant-Man shrinks Cross's suit so far that it collapses in on him.
Cross, rebuilt by Kang as M.O.D.O.K., hunts Scott, then turns on Kang and dies.

k: A HYDRA agent and former S.H.I.E.L.D. official
st: Carson tries to buy Yellowjacket for HYDRA and slips away with a vial of the formula.

k: A Sokovian colonel seeking revenge on the Avengers
st: Zemo frames Bucky for the UN bombing and turns Iron Man against Captain America.
T'Challa stops Zemo from taking his own life and hands him over to the authorities.
Bucky breaks Zemo out of prison to help hunt the super soldier serum.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Zemo surrenders to the Dora Milaje, then has the captured Flag Smashers killed from the Raft.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: A HYDRA officer who ran the Winter Soldier
st: In 1991, Karpov sends the Winter Soldier to kill Howard and Maria Stark.
Zemo tortures Karpov for the Winter Soldier's code words and kills him.

k: Head of the Red Room
st: Dreykov runs the Red Room and controls an army of Widows with chemicals.
Natasha breaks his control, and Dreykov dies when the Red Room falls.

k: A masked fighter who copies any fighting style
st: Taskmaster hunts Natasha for Dreykov, and turns out to be his daughter Antonia.
Natasha frees Antonia from Dreykov's control.
Valentina sends Antonia into a vault trap with other assets, and Ghost shoots her dead.

k: A mystery woman who visits Yelena
st: Valentina tells Yelena at Natasha's grave that Clint Barton killed her sister.
Valentina recruits the disgraced John Walker as U.S. Agent.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Now CIA director, Valentina arrests her ex-husband Everett Ross.
Valentina tries to erase her secret projects, then calls the survivors the New Avengers to save herself.

k: An ex-US black ops soldier with ties to Wakanda
st: Erik, son of N'Jobu, kills Klaue and wins Wakanda's throne in ritual combat.
T'Challa beats Killmonger, who chooses death over prison.
Shuri meets Killmonger in the Ancestral Plane, and he urges her to take revenge.

k: Head of Wakanda's Border Tribe
st: W'Kabi backs Killmonger and leads the Border Tribe against T'Challa, then surrenders to Okoye.

k: A salvage boss selling alien-tech weapons
st: Adrian Toomes's crew steals alien tech after the Battle of New York and sells it as weapons.
Spider-Man saves Toomes from his own crash, and he goes to prison.

k: Toomes's crew member with a shock gauntlet
st: Schultz takes over as the Shocker and is left webbed up for the police.

k: The first Shocker in Toomes's crew
st: Toomes fires Brice for drawing attention, then kills him by accident with an alien gun.

k: Toomes's weapons builder
st: Mason builds Toomes's alien-tech weapons, including the Vulture's wings.

k: A criminal buying Toomes's weapons
st: Gargan's ferry deal goes wrong, and Spider-Man leaves him for the FBI.
In prison, Gargan presses Toomes to name Spider-Man.
Jean Grey frees Gargan from Damage Control and controls him as the Scorpion, until Spider-Man beats him.

k: A rogue master of the mystic arts
st: Kaecilius steals rites from Kamar-Taj and attacks the Sanctums to bring Dormammu to Earth.
Strange bargains with Dormammu, who drags Kaecilius into the Dark Dimension.

k: A zealot following Kaecilius
st: Lucian attacks Strange at the New York Sanctum, and Strange kills him.

k: Ruler of the Dark Dimension
st: Strange traps Dormammu in a time loop until he agrees to leave Earth alone.

k: A master of the mystic arts at Kamar-Taj
st: Mordo quits Kamar-Taj and starts stripping sorcerers of their power.
A variant of Mordo on Earth-838 captures Strange for the Illuminati.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

k: Odin's firstborn, the Goddess of Death
st: Hela breaks Mjolnir, seizes Asgard, and slaughters its army.
Thor unleashes Surtur, who destroys Asgard with Hela on it.

k: Asgard's new gatekeeper
st: Skurge serves as Hela's executioner, then dies defending Asgard's people.

k: A fire demon who foretells Ragnarok
st: Thor beats Surtur in Muspelheim and takes his crown.
Loki revives Surtur in Asgard's vault, and Surtur destroys Asgard.

k: Ruler of Sakaar and its Contest of Champions
st: The Grandmaster forces Thor to fight the Hulk, and his people rise up and overthrow him.

k: A telekinetic member of Thanos's Black Order
st: Ebony Maw attacks New York for the Time Stone and takes Doctor Strange prisoner.
Iron Man and Spider-Man blow Maw out of his ship into space.
A 2014 Maw fights at the Avengers Compound and turns to dust.

k: A warrior of Thanos's Black Order
st: Proxima ambushes Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh, then leads the attack on Wakanda.
Wanda throws Proxima into the path of the army's threshers.
A 2014 Proxima fights at the Avengers Compound and turns to dust.

k: A warrior of Thanos's Black Order
st: Corvus attacks Vision in Edinburgh and again in Wakanda, where Vision kills him with his own glaive.
A 2014 Corvus fights at the Avengers Compound, where Okoye stabs him, and he turns to dust after Tony's snap.

k: The brute of Thanos's Black Order
st: Cull Obsidian fights in New York and Wakanda, and dies when Bruce drives him into the energy shield.
A 2014 Cull Obsidian fights at the Avengers Compound, and Giant-Man steps on him.

k: A masked thief who phases through walls
st: Ava Starr steals Hank Pym's lab, hoping its quantum energy will cure her pain.
Janet eases Ava's pain, and she leaves with Bill Foster.
Ava kills Taskmaster in Valentina's vault, then joins the team that becomes the New Avengers.

k: Hank Pym's former partner
st: Bill Foster helps Ghost hunt Hank Pym's lab to cure her, then leaves with her.
